# ex: implicit deref with outer & operator cancels
ex {
	var t T
	t.X -> t.Y
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func F(p *T) *int {
	return &p.X
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -6,5 +6,5 @@
 }

 func F(p *T) *int {
-	return &p.X
+	return &p.Y
 }
